vidIQ MCP

vidIQ MCP lets authorized agents research YouTube and Instagram creators, videos, trends, comments, thumbnails, titles, and connected-channel analytics, with explicitly annotated media and account-management actions.

61 actionsAPI key

Connect vidIQ MCP

What your bot can do in vidIQ MCP

Looks up

  • Vidiq balanceCheck the user's current vidIQ credits balance.
  • Vidiq channel analyticsGet YouTube Analytics data for a channel you own — views, watch time, subscribers gained, likes, comments, retention, traffic sources,…
  • Vidiq channel performance trendsGet a channel's typical video performance curve — how views accumulate over time after publication.
  • Vidiq channel searchComprehensive YouTube channel search.
  • Vidiq channel statsGet YouTube channel statistics including subscriber count, total views, video count, and growth over a configurable time period.
  • Vidiq channel videosGet videos from a YouTube channel by format (long-form, Shorts, or live streams).
  • Vidiq comment insightsAnalyze YouTube audience comments for a niche.
  • Vidiq earnings calculateCalculate estimated monthly YouTube earnings (low/mid/high USD) for a given number of monthly views.
  • Vidiq generate brollFind free stock B-roll video clips.
  • Vidiq generate comment repliesGenerate multiple draft replies to one viewer comment on a YouTube video, with one reply per requested tone.
